اخرنطموا (form IIIq)
# اِخْرَنْطَمُوا (iḵranṭamū) /ix.ran.tˤa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# اِخْرَنْطِمُوا (iḵranṭimū) /ix.ran.tˤi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
